title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 Noether record: complete French Paper 02 pilot
description:
Dedicated Emmy Noether record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. The top-level PDFs expose source-checkable German modern LaTeX, English high-fidelity translations, and current multilingual pilot translations.

Status at a glance. [##########] numbered-paper German/English stream: Papers 1-43 complete and audited; [###-------] multilingual stream: Paper 01 pilots in Spanish, Japanese, and French, Paper 02 through sections before 7 in Spanish/Japanese, and complete Paper 02 in French; [##########] source/artifact preservation: TeX, source-scan witnesses, audit notes, and glossary deltas are preserved in ZIP artifacts.

Latest update. Added the complete French Paper 02 pilot translation, including final symbolic tables, glossary normalization, cumulative TeX/PDF, and compact source/witness ZIP.
notes: Latest update adds complete French Paper 02 pilot translation with cumulative TeX/PDF and component witnesses.
